title: Legacy Compliance Audit Automation
business: Financial institutions maintaining long-term regulatory archives.
problem: Manual review of legacy documentation is costly and prone to human error, especially when dealing with complex, multi-year compliance requirements that exceed the reasoning capabilities of smaller, faster models.
solution: Utilizing the extended thinking capabilities of Claude Opus 4.5 allows for deep, methodical analysis of dense regulatory text within its 200K token context window, ensuring high-fidelity extraction of compliance obligations.
steps: Ingest historical compliance PDFs into a structured vector database.
Define a system prompt that leverages the extended thinking mode to evaluate document segments against current regulatory standards.
Execute batch processing requests using the claude-opus-4-5-20251101 model ID to analyze document chunks.
Aggregate the model's reasoning outputs to generate a final compliance gap report.
outcome: A consistent, auditable trail of reasoning that identifies potential regulatory non-compliance in legacy archives without requiring manual intervention.
limitation: As a legacy model, Claude Opus 4.5 has a knowledge cutoff of May 2025, meaning it cannot natively understand regulatory changes enacted after that date. Verification requires checking the model's output against a post-May 2025 regulatory database.
